# World Battery Hub — Data

> Battery specification data reference — BCI battery group sizes, chemistry comparison, cold cranking amps, dimensions/terminal layouts, and weight charts. Data-driven sub-site of the World Battery Hub family.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://data.worldbatteryhub.com/): Entry point to the battery data reference.
- [Battery Groups](https://data.worldbatteryhub.com/battery-groups/): BCI battery group-size specifications (individual group pages via /battery-groups/[group]/).
- [Chemistries](https://data.worldbatteryhub.com/chemistries/): Battery chemistry overview and comparison (individual chemistry pages via /chemistries/[chemistry]/).
- [CCA](https://data.worldbatteryhub.com/cca/): Cold cranking amps reference values.
- [Dimensions & Terminals](https://data.worldbatteryhub.com/dimensions-terminals/): Physical dimensions and terminal layouts.
- [Weight Chart](https://data.worldbatteryhub.com/weight-chart/): Battery weight reference data.

## Main site

- [World Battery Hub](https://worldbatteryhub.com/): Main knowledge hub (guides, tools, glossary, methodology).

## Notes

- Specification values are general reference data and may vary by manufacturer and model; confirm against manufacturer datasheets before ordering.
- This is a sub-site in the World Battery Hub family; see the main site's llms.txt for the full family.
